title: A realizable (19,12) landing cell forces an extra O or another R_ε block
statement: After a realized length-19 near-return with odd count 12, the landing cell of the endpoint forces either an extra odd letter within bounded depth (leaving hug at or before the first hug-E) or the start of another R_0.05 fan block.
counterexamples: window n<=2000: 12 odd (19,12) landings are hug_follow_die (no extra O, no R_0.05 block); 5 of those are OOE-legal, the same cell type as all 5 extra_O landings
n=193,539,1119,1121,1459: OOE-legal landings whose next prefix is OOE (hug-compatible through letter 3) then die before length 19
odd-cell key (ooe,oe,mod 8) is mixed on both windows; xi ranges of hug_follow_die and extra_O both cover nearly (0,1)
mathematical_domain: Juggler descent-free flights / fan-block landing cells
notes: Phase 0 on existing fan-concat endpoints only. extra_O implies OOE-legal (image odd) but the converse fails. Next letters are T; even descent is even_cell. Not a xi-cocycle reopen, not a mechanical-lift reopen, not a halt theorem, no n_max raise, no Paper A, no ledger row.
tested_range: 44 length-19 near-returns on n<=2000 and 8 on the seven high-flyers
